Sir:

I am writing on behalf of Mrs. Woo Lieu Sz
（吳劉氏）, widow of the late Woo Ting Fong
（吳定芳）, deceased, who was kidnapped on
May 26th this year, and who, in an attempt to

through an upper window of that house and sustained
injuries from which he died on June 15th, to inform
you that she desires to offer a reward of $1,000.00,

responsible for the kidnapping of her late husband.

I am instructed to request that you kindly
give this matter your attention and would appreciate
very much the assistance of yourself and your staff.

本人謹代表已故吳定芳（Woo Ting Fong）之遺孀吳劉氏（Mrs. Woo Lieu Sz）致函閣下。吳定芳於今年5月26日遭綁架，在試圖從綁匪魔掌中逃脫時，於拉達路（Rue Ratard）新成里（Sze Zing Lee）2號從該房屋樓上窗戶跳下，受傷後於6月15日身亡。現告知閣下，她願提供賞金壹仟圓（本地貨幣），以緝拿對其亡夫綁架案負責之人。

August 12, 1931.

D. C. (Crime Branch).

Sir,

I have to report that on June 29 the wife of the
late Wu Ding Yong (吴廷芳) accompanied by her adopted son
and another man Yue Ziang Tsing (余祥琴) came to my office
and reported to me the circumstances surrounding the armed
abduction and the subsequent death of her deceased husband.
I in turn reported to you, and in accordance with your
instructions a statement was taken by Clerk Wong from the
complainant.

According to the words of Mrs. Wu her deceased
husband was, for many years, the chief accountant of the
瑞康顏料號
Tsui Kong Dye Firm at Shantung Road. During the recent
few years a number of men of the firm (proprietors and
members of staff) have been victimised by armed kidnappers,
her deceased husband being one of the victims. Among the
shareholders of the firm victimised are the son of Pei Zung-
sung (貝潤生), the son of Yee Ngoh-ngan (奚萼銜), Wu Mei-
sung (吳梅生) and Wong Ding-yuen (王定源), all of whom were,
one after the other, carried-away by force and released upon
the payment of a ransom. Mrs. Wu attributed the cause of
the armed kidnapping of men belonging to the Tsui Kong Dye
Firm to the existence in the firm of a man who conspired
with armed kidnappers and who carried out kidnapping and
conducted negotiations re the payment of a ransom. The
man's name was mentioned in Mrs. Wu's statement. Mrs. Wu
also admitted that she was failed at that time and being

1931年8月12日。

致：刑事科副總監（D. C.）。

先生：

職謹報告，6月29日，已故吳廷芳（Wu Ding Yong）之妻子在其養子及另一名男子余祥琴（Yue Ziang Tsing）陪同下來到職辦公室，向職報告了其亡夫遭武裝綁架及隨後死亡之情況。職隨即向閣下報告，並按照閣下之指示，由黃書記員從投訴人處錄取了口供。

據吳夫人稱，其亡夫多年來一直擔任山東路瑞康顏料號（Tsui Kong Dye Firm）之首席會計。在最近幾年間，該商號之多名人員（業主及職員）成為武裝綁匪之受害者，其亡夫即為受害者之一。該商號股東中受害之人包括貝潤生（Pei Zung-sung）之子、奚萼銜（Yee Ngoh-ngan）之子、吳梅生（Wu Mei-sung）及王定源（Wong Ding-yuen），他們均先後被強行擄走，並在支付贖金後獲釋。吳夫人認為，瑞康顏料號人員屢遭武裝綁架之原因，在於商號內部有一人與武裝綁匪勾結，實施綁架並就贖金支付進行談判。吳夫人在口供中提到了該人之姓名。吳夫人亦承認，她當時感到沮喪，且因

pages.en:
- 2 -

feeling sorrowful for the incapability of getting
a redress and learning that we are men of justice she
ventured to come forward and lay the case before you with
a view of getting a redress.

In consequence of the above complaint I received
your instructions to make an investigation into the
different cases of armed abduction of men of the said
Tsui Kong Dye Firm. From enquiries made it was ascertained
that the son of Pei Zung-sung, the son and nephew of Yee Ngoh-
ngan and Wu Mei-sung were □□, one after the other, kidnapped
and released upon the payment of a ransom. In every one of
the above cases it was one and the same man mentioned in com-
plainant's statement and belonging to the Tsui Kong Dye Firm,
who acted as negotiator and through whose hands the ransom
was paid, but all the victims' families withheld the truth
and did not report this fact to the Police, thus enhancing
the audacity of the bandits and leading to so many armed
abductions among men of the same firm. In the present
instance the death of Wu Ding Yong seemed to call for a
thorough investigation, and, in order to get sufficient
evidence, it was deemed necessary that thorough enquiries
should be made from all those victims.

In accordance with your instructions I called at
Mr. Pei's house at 5.30 p.m. on July 12, but I did not meet
Mr. Pei, for, according to his watchman's words, Mr. Pei is
now away from Shanghai. At 5.40 p.m. I visited Mr. Yee's
house, but Mr. Yee happened to be absent from home. I
called at the latter place again at 6 p.m. on July 14 and
interviewed Chen Sz-ching (周士清), Mr. Yee's accountant,
also Mr. Yee's elder brother and Yue Siang-jin (余祥琴).
I told them that you would like to have a little talk with
Mr. Yee at Police Headquarters and explained to them that,
although the Police are responsible for the safety of the
pages.zh:
- 2 -

無法獲得補救而感到悲傷，得知我等乃正義之士，故大膽前來向閣下陳情，以期獲得補救。

鑑於上述投訴，職接到閣下指示，對該瑞康顏料號人員遭武裝綁架之各起案件進行調查。經查詢查明，貝潤生之子、奚萼銜之子及侄子以及吳梅生□□，先後被綁架，並在支付贖金後獲釋。在上述每一案件中，均由投訴人口供中提到之同一名屬於瑞康顏料號之男子擔任談判者，贖金亦經其手支付，但所有受害者家屬均隱瞞真相，未將此事實報告警方，從而助長了匪徒之氣焰，導致該商號人員屢遭武裝綁架。在本案中，吳廷芳之死似乎需要徹底調查，且為了獲取充分證據，認為有必要向所有受害者進行徹底查問。

按照閣下之指示，職於7月12日下午5時30分前往貝先生寓所，但未見到貝先生，據其門房稱，貝先生現已離開上海。下午5時40分，職造訪奚先生寓所，但奚先生恰好不在家。職於7月14日下午6時再次前往該處，會見了奚先生之會計周士清（Chen Sz-ching）、奚先生之兄長及余祥琴（Yue Siang-jin）。職告訴他們，閣下希望在警務處總部與奚先生簡談，並向他們解釋說，雖然警方負責租界居民之安全，但居民也應協助警方。周先生隨後答應讓奚先生於1931年7月16日下午6時在家中等候職。職於1931年7月15日下午5時30分前往奚先生寓所，被告知奚先生患病，故未能再次會見他。

1931年7月16日下午5時，吳夫人及甘月松（Kan Yoeh-soong）先生來到職辦公室，提供了關於死者吳定芳被綁案之進一步詳情。他們亦於17日下午3時接受了閣下之問話。

21日，余姓男子持已呈交閣下之介紹名片來到職位於康納特路（Connaught Road）138號之寓所。他詢問職對吳定芳一案之看法。職認為此問題不合情理，未予回答，並於當日將此事實報告閣下。他於25日再次來到職寓所，職明確告訴他不應再來拜訪。吳夫人之養子及女婿於27日下午2時來到職寓所，要求撤銷此案。甘月松及余祥琴先生亦於28日下午5時帶著同樣請求來見閣下，當時閣下向他們解釋了案情。

29日，職前往吳梅生先生處，留話請吳先生來總部。次日（30日），吳先生之代理人黃元浩（Huang Yuen-hao）來到職辦公室，稱吳先生不在上海，他將 accordingly 寫信給吳先生。

除奚萼銜（Yee Ngo-ngan）因病並承諾康復後立即拜訪閣下外，其餘人員（我們希望從其處獲取一些資訊者）似乎均以各種藉口不願與職會面。

據吳夫人稱，瑞康顏料號人員屢遭武裝綁架係歸因於

pages.en:
- 3 -

residents in the Settlement, the residents should also
assist the Police. Mr. Cheu than promised to ask Mr.
Yee to wait for me in his home at 6 p.m. on 16-7-31. I
proceeded to Mr. Yee's house at 5.30 p.m. 15-7-31 and
was told that Mr. Yee was sick, so I could not meet him
again.

At 5 p.m. on 16-7-31 Mrs. Wu and Mr. Kan Yoeh-
soong (甘月松) came to my office and gave further particulars
about the deceased Wu Ding Fong's abduction. They were
also interviewed by you at 3 p.m. on the 17th.

On the 21st the man Yu came to my house, No.138
Connaught Road, with a card of introduction which has been
presented to you. He asked me about my opinion vis-a-vis
Wu Ding Fong's case. I considered this question unreason-
able and did not answer him, which fact was reported to you
on the same day. He came to my house again on the 25th
when I plainly told him that he should not call on me again.
Mrs. Wu's adopted son and son-in-law came to my house at
2 p.m. on the 27th asking that the case be dropped. Messrs.
Kan Yoeh-soong and Yue Ziang Tsing also came to see you at
5 p.m. on the 28th with the same request, when you explained
the case to them.

On the 29th I went to Mr. Wu Mei-sung's place and left
word for Mr. Wu to come to Headquarters. The next day (30th)
Mr. Wu's deputy Huang Yuen-hao came to my office and said
that Mr. Wu was not in Shanghai and that he would write him
accordingly.

With the exception of Yee Ngo-ngan who is sick and
who has promised to call on you as soon as he has recovered,
the rest of the persons (from whom we desire to get some
information) all seemed to be disinclined to meet me under
one pretext or the other.

According to the statement of Mrs. Wu the repeated
armed kidnapping of men of the Tsui Kong Dye Firm was
pages.zh:
- 3 -

貝、奚、吳及王等人之非法行為，他們只顧暫時安寧，無視公共安全，且雖明知其僱員為武裝綁匪，卻為其保密並以金錢賄賂之。因此，合理建議為維護治安起見，亦應對這些人嚴加懲處。

警司曾贊尼（Tsang Zang-nee）。

attributed to the unlawful action of Pei, Yee, Wu and
Wong who cared only for temporary peace and disregarded
public safety and who, though well knowing the man in
their employ to be an armed kidnapper, kept secrets for
him and bribed him with money. It is therefore
reasonable to suggest that in the interests of peace and
good order these men should also be severely dealt with.

Superintendent Tsang Zang-nee.

Please also inform Chang by
Yu Hung Sun at home of

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Ng Lieu Shih (吳劉氏)
native of Yangchow taken by me Clerk Huang Ming-fu
at H.Q. on the 29th June and interpreted by

I, Ng Lieu Shih, age 42, native of Yangchow, Kiangsu,
reside at No. 2 Chuin Yih Li alleyway, West Gate Road and Rue
Amiral Bayle, French Concession. My deceased husband Ng Ding-
fong (吳廷芳), native of Ningpo, age 44, was the chief account-
ant of the Land Estate Department of the Tsui Kong Dye Shop
(Vong Bing Ka). At 2 a.m. on May 27 last my deceased husband
left the Tai Chong Club on Bubbling Well Road for home by a
motor car belonging to one Ng Dong-vung (吳同文). On reaching
the entrance to the Chuin Yih Li alleyway my deceased husband
left the car and walked into the alleyway wherein he was
kidnapped. I did not know his abduction until the next day.

Prior to my deceased husband's kidnapping, Messrs.
Pei Zung-sung (貝潤生), Wong Pao-hu (王寶和), Yee Ngoh-nyien
(葉鶚年), Ng Mei-sung (吳梅生) and one Zau (趙), all proprietors
of the dye company to which my deceased husband belonged, were
kidnapped one after another and were, it is said, released upon
the payment of a ransom through the hands of one Wong Zung-ts
(王承之). Wong Zung-ts, residing at No.1 Vallon Terrace,
Route Vallon, in the French Concession, is an accountant of the
same shop mentioned above.

In the 11th moon last year a party of police came to
the shop in question to arrest Wong Zung-ts and Sih Bei-quan
(鮮培坤) in connection with the kidnapping of Mr. Ng Mei-sung.
Sih Bei-quan escaped, whilst Wong Zung-ts was arrested on the
spot, but he was released in the very evening upon the payment,
it is said, of $50,000.

本人吳劉氏，42歲，江蘇揚州人，居住於法租界西門路與貝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）交界處之純益里（Chuin Yih Li）2號弄堂。本人亡夫吳廷芳（Ng Ding-fong），44歲，寧波人，係瑞康顏料店（Vong Bing Ka）地產部之首席會計。去年5月27日凌晨2時，本人亡夫乘坐吳同文（Ng Dong-vung）先生之汽車，從靜安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）之大中俱樂部回家。到達純益里弄堂入口時，本人亡夫下車步入弄堂，隨即遭綁架。直至次日，本人才知其被綁。

在本人亡夫被綁之前，屬於本人亡夫所在顏料公司之業主貝潤生（Pei Zung-sung）、王寶和（Wong Pao-hu）、葉鶚年（Yee Ngoh-nyien）、吳梅生（Ng Mei-sung）及趙姓一人（Zau），先後被綁架，據稱均通過王承之（Wong Zung-ts）之手支付贖金後獲釋。王承之居住於法租界萬隆路（Route Vallon）萬隆別墅（Vallon Terrace）1號，係上述同一商號之會計。

去年農曆十一月，一批警察前往該商號逮捕與吳梅生先生綁架案有關之王承之及鮮培坤（Sih Bei-quan）。鮮培坤逃脫，而王承之當場被捕，但據稱當晚支付伍萬圓後即獲釋。

Before my deceased husband was kidnapped, he used to
advise Wong Jung-ts to beware his reputation and that of the
shop, thereby incurring his enmity, whilst Wong's wife often
came to our house and made enquiries in a casual way about the
movements of my deceased husband and the time of his returning

the tiffin time of the very same day I received from post a
letter written by my deceased husband advising me to keep the
matter confidential and not to report to the Police. When

and conduct negotiations. I have therefore to introduce

who will conduct negotiations on your behalf. I don't think
that the matter can be settled by hundreds or thousands (of
dollars) and am of opinion that tens of thousands will be

在本人亡夫被綁之次日晚上，王承之（Wong Jung-ts）與當地紳士虞洽卿（Yu Yah-Ching）先生之叔父虞銘聲（Yu Ming-sung）一同來到本人家中，同時，大中俱樂部之侍者萬春（Van Tsung）亦進入本人家中。就在當天午飯時間，本人收到亡夫來信一封，囑咐本人對此事宜保密，切勿報警。當這三人進入本人家中時，王開始對本人說道：

I at once replied that I would not be able to raise such a large sum of money and that the only way open to me was to drown myself in the Whangpoo River. Upon hearing these words Wong Zung-ts showed some displeasure in his face and immediately left our house together with the two others after giving me the telephone number of Mr. Yu Ming-sung.

On May 31 a second letter was received telling us to send some one to wait on the street opposite the Jungkow Hotel for the purpose of opening negotiations. I at once notified Wong Wing-ts who engaged on his own initiative a Room No.251 in the New World Hotel and who sent a friend of his named Ching (金) to the appointed place to negotiate with the bandits. The man Ching later returned and reported that he met two bandits but that no formal negotiations took place. Wong Zung-ts then said to me that it would be better for me to stay in the New World Hotel. I did not fall in with his proposal and returned to my home. In the room there were at that time the man Ching, Fong Mei-fu (方梅甫) and Yu Ming-sung. The room was retained for 3 days, but, as there was no news from the kidnappers, it was disengaged.

On June 11 a third letter was received instructing us to send some one to the place in front of the Kiu Sing Cinema (九星影戲院) at the boundary between the British Settlement and the French Concession. The letter required that the man sent for the purpose should hold in his hand a packet of Mary.

死讯，直到17日，我们在报纸上看到一则关于有人从房屋高处跳楼身亡的报道，并附有我丈夫店铺发出的消息。得知我丈夫死讯后，我想去警察局报案，但虞铭声试图阻止我，警告我不要说出真相，而是说我丈夫几十天才回家一次。当我们在警局时，他让我保持沉默，而他自己则编造了许多谎言，说我丈夫几十天才回家一次，且在他被绑架后未收到绑匪的勒索信。当我说收到了绑匪的信件时，虞用手捂住我的嘴，不让我说话。后来我回家安排丧事。

I, Ng Lieu Shih, age 42, native of Yangchow, Kiangsu,
reside at No. 2 Chuin Yih Li alleyway, West Gate Road and Rue
Amiral Bayle, French Concession. My deceased husband Ng Ding-
fong (吳廷芳), native of Ningpo, age 44, was the chief account-
ant of the Land Estate Department of the Tsui Hong Dye Shop
(Vong Bing Ka). At 2 a.m. on May 27 last my deceased husband
left the Tai Chong Club on Bubbling Well Road for home by a
motor car belonging to one Ng Dong-vung (吳同文). On reaching
the entrance to the Chuin Yih Li alleyway my deceased husband
left the car and walked into the alleyway wherein he was
kidnapped. I did not know his abduction until the next day.
Prior to my deceased husband's kidnapping, Messrs.
Pei Zung-sung (貝潤生), Wong Pao-hu (王寶和), Yee Ngoh-nyien
(奚鄂年), Ng Mei-sung (吳梅生) and one Zau (趙), all proprietors
of the dye company to which my deceased husband belonged, were
kidnapped one after another and were, it is said, released upon
the payment of a ransom through the hands of one Wong Zung-ts
(王承之). Wong Zung-ts, residing at No.1 Vallon Terrace,
Route Vallon, in the French Concession, is an accountant of the
same shop mentioned above.
In the 11th moon last year a party of police came to
the shop in question to arrest Wong Zung-ts and Sih Bei-quan
(鮮培坤) in connection with the kidnapping of Mr. Ng Mei-sung.
Sih Bei-quan escaped, whilst Wong Zung-ts was arrested on the
spot, but he was released in the very evening upon the payment
it is said, of $50,000.

在我已故丈夫被绑架之前，属于我已故丈夫所在染行的老板裴润生（Pei Zung-sung）、王宝和（Wong Pao-hu）、奚鄂年（Yee Ngoh-nyien）、吴梅生（Ng Mei-sung）以及一名赵姓男子（Zau），相继被绑架，据说都是通过王承之（Wong Zung-ts）之手支付赎金后获释的。王承之住在法租界万隆路（Route Vallon）万隆别墅1号，是上述同一家店铺的会计师。

Zung-ts came to our home and reprimanded us for having supplied the
information to the newspapers.

All the suspicious points indicate that Wong Zung-ts
et al are under grave suspicion of being concerned in the case.
This is a true statement.
(Crossed) Ng Lieh Shih.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

警务调查报告。

以下系
籍贯为 ____________________ 的 ____________________ 的供词，由本人 ____________________ 于 ____________________ 在 ____________________ 记录，并由 ____________________ 翻译。

死讯，直到17日，我们在报纸上读到一则关于有人从房屋高处跳楼身亡的报道，并附有我丈夫商号的消息。收到我丈夫的死讯后，我想去警察局报案，但余玲生（Yu Ling-sung）试图阻止我，并警告我不要说实话，而是说我丈夫几十天才回家一次。当我们在警局时，他让我保持沉默，而他自己则撒了很多谎，说我丈夫几十天才回家一次，并且在他被绑架后没有收到绑匪索要钱财的信件。当我说收到了绑匪的信件时，余用手捂住我的嘴，从而阻止我说话。后来我回家安排丧事。

余曾向我要“谈判费”。由于未说明具体金额，我没有给他。

在我已故丈夫去世前，他曾写信给黄宗氏，请求他协助自己获释。这封信是由黄宗氏亲自读给我听的，并被黄带走。该信是否仍然存在，不得而知。

后来，当我的养子将案件的真实情况告知记者并在报纸上发表后，黄宗氏来到我家，斥责我们向报纸提供消息。

所有可疑之处均表明，黄宗氏等人有重大涉案嫌疑。
此陈述属实。
（签名）吴烈氏（Ng Lieh Shih）。

pages.en:
Translation of the attached letters.

No. 1.

May 27, 1931.

I have to inform you that Mr. Ng has been
invited to our place and is going to have a trip to
outports. Don't get excited and keep the matter
strictly confidential. Don't report to the Police.
If you do, our comrades will get angry and Mr. Ng's
life will then be in danger. This is an important
advice. A further communication will be addressed
to you in a few days. Please wait patiently for
good news.

Chao Yih San (趙益三).
------------------
No. 2.

May 28, 1931.

My dear wife Mr Pao,

Whilst I was walking in the alleyway on my
way home, I was invited by some men to go away with
them. I am now safe, so you need not get excited.
As this is a very important matter, you must keep
it strictly confidential. As soon as the letter
reaches you, you should ask some one to take up
negotiations. Don't delay. I know very well that
we have not enough money, but I hope that you will go
and ask the help of my office comrades. Tell them
that I will repay them by instalments as soon as I
get back. I sincerely hope that you will take our
companionship lasting over ten years into considera-
tion by making efforts (to save me).

Important: Keep this strictly confidential.

Ding Feng.
pages.zh:
附件信件译文。

第1号。

1931年5月27日。

特此通知，吴先生已被邀请至我方处所，并将前往外地旅行。请勿惊慌，并对此事严格保密。切勿向警方报告。如果你这样做，我们的同志会生气，吴先生的生命就会有危险。这是重要的忠告。几天后将再次与你联系。请耐心等待好消息。

赵益三（Chao Yih San）。
------------------
第2号。

1931年5月28日。

亲爱的妻子包先生（Mr Pao，原文如此），

我在回家途中走在弄堂里时，被几个人邀请随他们离开。我现在很安全，所以你不必惊慌。由于此事非常重要，你必须严格保密。信一到你手，你应立即找人进行谈判。切勿拖延。我很清楚我们没有足够的钱，但我希望你能去请求我办公室同事的帮助。告诉他们，我一回来就会分期偿还他们。我真诚地希望你考虑到我们十多年的伴侣情谊，努力（救我）。

重要提示：对此严格保密。

丁凤（Ding Feng）。

pages.en:
Sheet No.2.

No. 3.

May 28, 1931.

With reference to my last letter and to Mr.
Ng's own note I have to inform you that owing to the
present state of emergency our army will soon be
mobilized, but we are badly short of military funds.
I have asked Mr. Ng to assist, and he has promised to
do so and also told us to notify you. As soon as you
get this letter, send a reliable representative to the
west entrance of the Market on Soochow Road between
7.30 p.m. and 8 p.m. on May 29 (tomorrow). The
representative should stand face to face with the Zung
Chow Hotel and should carry a straw hat in his hands.
When the time is past, neither side will wait. This
is an important advice. If you deliberately ignore
this letter or leak out any information, we shall shoot
and kill Mr. Ng without fail. This serves as a warning.
Remember it, or it will be too late for you to repent.

Chao Yih San.
----------
No. 4.

May 29, 1931.

With reference to my letter of yesterday asking
you to send some one to negotiate with us opposite the
Zung Chow Hotel I have to inform you that your man did
not turn up at the time appointed. I now offer you
another appointment (chance). Send some one to the
tram step in front of the Central Hotel on Canton Road
between 7 & 7.30 p.m. on May 31 (day after tomorrow).
Your man should carry in his left hand a straw hat and
should be honest and reliable, otherwise we shall not
hold any conversation with him. If he fails to come
at the appointed time again, we shall not write you any
more, and if you fail to keep this letter strictly
pages.zh:
第2页。

第3号。

1931年5月28日。

参照我上一封信及吴先生本人的便条，特此通知，鉴于目前的紧急状态，我军即将动员，但军费严重短缺。我已请吴先生协助，他已答应帮忙，并让我们通知你。你一收到此信，请于5月29日（明天）晚上7:30至8:00之间，派一名可靠的代表到苏州路市场西入口。代表应面向中州饭店（Zung Chow Hotel）站立，手中拿一顶草帽。时间一过，双方均不再等待。这是重要的忠告。如果你故意无视此信或泄露任何信息，我们将必定枪杀吴先生。特此警告。切记，否则后悔莫及。

赵益三。
----------
第4号。

1931年5月29日。

参照我昨天请你派人到中州饭店对面与我们谈判的信，特此通知，你的人未在约定时间出现。现再给你一次约会（机会）。请于5月31日（后天）晚上7:00至7:30之间，派人到广东路中央饭店（Central Hotel）前的电车台阶处。你的人左手应持一顶草帽，且必须诚实可靠，否则我们将不与他交谈。如果他再次未在约定时间前来，我们将不再给你写信，如果你不能对此信严格

pages.en:
Sheet No.3.
No. 4 (Contd).

confidential or if you purposely leak out any
information, we shall not hesitate to deal with
Mr. Ng with stern measures. Don't say in future
that we give you no warning.
Future communications will bear a chop.

Chao Yih San.
------------
No. 5A.

June 7, 1931.

Madam Ng,
I have no doubt that my last two letters
must have reached your hands.
Owing to his nervousness Mr. Ng is rather
indisposed and has requested us to ask you to
negotiate with us personally. If you have no
intention to save Mr. Ng, don't come. If you have
some affection for your husband, keep this strictly
confidential. Wait for us personally at the entrance
to the Chin Sing Cinema west of the Loh Ka Kuan Ying
Tong between 7.30 p.m. and 8 p.m. on the 9th, Tuesday.
Don't bring with you any stranger. You must carry
a book in your left hand as a mark of distinction.
If you fail to act accordingly or if you do not bring
some 'negotiation funds' with you, we shall not discuss
with you. If it comes to our knowledge that you have
leaked out any information, it will be dangerous to
Mr. Ng. Remember this.

Chao Yih San.
P.S.- Our future communications will bear our chop.
------------
pages.zh:
第3页。
第4号（续）。

保密，或故意泄露任何信息，我们将毫不犹豫地采取严厉措施处置吴先生。日后勿说我们未给你警告。
今后的通信将加盖印章。

赵益三。
------------
第5A号。

1931年6月7日。

吴夫人：
我确信我最近的两封信已送达你手。
由于紧张，吴先生身体不适，请求我们让你亲自与我们谈判。如果你无意拯救吴先生，请不要来。如果你对丈夫尚有感情，请对此严格保密。请于9日，星期二，晚上7:30至8:00之间，在罗家花园影戏院（Loh Ka Kuan Ying Tong）西侧的新星电影院（Chin Sing Cinema）入口处亲自等候我们。不要带任何陌生人。你左手必须携带一本书作为识别标记。如果你不按此行事，或者不带一些“谈判资金”前来，我们将不与你商议。如果我们得知你泄露了任何信息，吴先生将有危险。切记。

赵益三。
附注：- 我们今后的通信将加盖我们的印章。
------------

pages.en:
Sheet No. 4.
No. 5 B.
(Undated).

If you sincerely desire to have the matter
settled, it is better for you to come personally
than to send some one else. You should come alone and
need entertain no fear, for we shall cause you no
trouble whatever. Don't show or tell any body about
this letter.

The entrance to the Central Hotel is not a
suitable place for negotiations, so we did not keep
the previous appointment.

If you fail to keep this appointment again, it
means that you have no sincerity.

Bad weather not excepted.

(Unsigned).
----------
No. 6.

June 9, 1931.

My dear wife Mr Pao,

They (the kidnappers) say that they do not
trust very much the man you definitely selected to negotiate.
I therefore earnestly hope that you will go in
company with a maid-servant to the entrance to the
Chiu Sing Cinema at the corner of Changpang and South
Chengtu Roads between 6.30 and 7 p.m. tomorrow and
wait there. You must carry in your hand one tin of
Mary cigarettes. There will be some one to approach
and negotiate with you. You can carry on negotiations
with him. There is no need for fear, for there will
not be the slightest danger. Don't delay. If you
procrastinate or if you do not come forward personally,
it will be too late, for the commander of the army (kid-
nappers) will soon leave for some other port. I am now
in a dangerous position and earnestly hope that you will
pages.zh:
第4页。
第5B号。
（无日期）。

如果你真心想解决此事，最好亲自前来，而不是派其他人。你应该独自前来，无需恐惧，因为我们绝不会给你制造任何麻烦。不要向任何人展示或提及此信。

中央饭店入口不适合谈判，所以我们未遵守之前的约会。

如果你再次失约，意味着你没有诚意。

恶劣天气也不例外。

（无签名）。
----------
第6号。

1931年6月9日。

亲爱的妻子包先生（Mr Pao，原文如此），

他们（绑匪）说，他们不太信任你明确选定进行谈判的那个人。
因此，我恳切希望你明天下午6:30至7:00之间，带一名女仆前往昌平路与成都南路拐角处的九星电影院（Chiu Sing Cinema）入口处，并在那里等候。你手中必须携带一罐玛丽牌（Mary）香烟。会有人来接近你并与你谈判。你可以与他进行谈判。无需恐惧，因为不会有任何危险。切勿拖延。如果你拖延或不亲自前来，那就太晚了，因为军队指挥官（绑匪）很快就要前往其他口岸。我现在处境危险，恳切希望你

pages.en:
Sheet No. 5.

No. 6 (Contd).

take our past affection into consideration by keeping
this appointment.

Ding Fong.
----------
No. 7 A.

June 15, 1931.

It has been several days since we had an
interview with your nephew, and no one has since come
to meet us.
Mr. Ng has been sick for some time and is
anxious to return home and get some medical treatment
and recuperation.
If you have approached your friends for assistance,
try to raise the money without delay in order to avoid
Mr. Ng becoming from bad to worse. If you haven't done
so, then send your nephew to the same place at 7 p.m.
on June 16 and to carry on negotiations with us. There
will not be any trouble to him. As to the amount of
the money there is ample room for discussion. It is
better still if you yourself go to the spot and discuss
with us personally. Don't fear. If you go, you should
carry a cigarette tin as was previously instructed as a
mark of distinction.
Two of Mr. Ng's own letters are enclosed.

Chao Yih San.
-------------
No. 7 B.

June 14, 1931.

My dear wife Mr Pae,
You failed to go to the appointed place as
was told in my last letter. Perhaps you are too
afraid to go. In reality you should have nothing to
pages.zh:
第5页。

第6号（续）。

能考虑到我们过去的情谊，遵守此次约会。

丁凤（Ding Fong）。
----------
第7A号。

1931年6月15日。

自从我们与你侄子会面以来，已经过了几天，此后无人来与我们见面。
吴先生已病了一段时间，急于回家接受治疗和休养。
如果你已向朋友求助，请设法尽快筹款，以免吴先生病情恶化。如果你尚未这样做，那么请于6月16日晚上7点派你的侄子到同一地点与我们进行谈判。他不会有任何麻烦。至于金额，仍有充分的讨论余地。如果你能亲自前往现场与我们当面商讨则更好。不要害怕。如果你去，应按先前指示携带一个香烟罐作为识别标记。
随信附上吴先生亲笔信两封。

赵益三。
-------------
第7B号。

1931年6月14日。

亲爱的妻子包先生（Mr Pae，原文如此），
你未按我上一封信所述前往约定地点。也许你太害怕不敢去。实际上你应该没有什么可

pages.en:
Sheet No. 6.
No. 7 B (contd).

fear, for there will not be any trouble.
They (the kidnappers) do not like to carry
on negotiations with the man you ~~selected~~ deputised, because
they do not trust him, so further negotiations through
him will be bound to failure. They now like to discuss
with you personally, for they know very well that you
are the dearest one to me. If you go and negotiate with
them, they will surely treat you with consideration and
refrain from using threats. Should you find any trouble,
you can refuse to go next time.
Upon the settlement of this matter depends the
solution of the other. I hope that you will boldly
attend the appointed place at the appointed time and with
the requisite article and a maid-servant. I shall never
ask you to go if there is the slightest danger. Don't
give ear to any other body who may warn you to do otherwise.
Your personal negotiation with the men will greatly facili-
tate the settlement of the matter. If you are asked about
the amount, you just tell them the sum you have raised, for
they know very well that we are not wealthy and will treat
us with consideration. Besides, your presence will dispel
any doubt that may exist in their minds.
As regards the procedure for the payment of money
you should insist on the place named by me with my own
handwriting in order to avoid trouble and to ensure my
release. They are also aware that the money was borrowed
and not my own property.
If you do not come forward personally now, the
matter will become a deadlock and further negotiations will
result in waste of time.
To me at present a day passes like a year. I am
anxiously waiting for rescue, so I write this to encourage
you to make personal efforts to save me. When you receive
this letter, you should ask some one to read to you
confidentially. You should by no means show it to any
pages.zh:
第6页。
第7 B号（续）。

恐惧，因为不会有任何麻烦。
他们（绑匪）不愿与你所~~选定~~委派的人进行谈判，因为
他们不信任他，所以通过他进行的进一步谈判注定会失败。他们现在希望
与你亲自商谈，因为他们非常清楚你是我最亲近的人。如果你去和他们谈判，
他们肯定会对你以礼相待，并避免使用威胁手段。若你发现任何麻烦，
下次可以拒绝前往。
此事的解决取决于另一件事的解决。我希望你能大胆地
在指定时间携带所需物品及一名女仆前往指定地点。如果存在丝毫危险，
我绝不会要求你去。不要听信任何可能警告你采取其他做法的人。
你与那些人亲自谈判将极大地促
进此事的解决。如果他们问起金额，你只需告诉他们你筹集到的数额，因
为他们非常清楚我们并不富有，并会因此对我们予以体谅。此外，你的到场将消除
他们心中可能存在的任何疑虑。
关于付款程序，
你应坚持在我亲笔书写的地点进行，以避免麻烦并确保我的
释放。他们也知晓这笔钱是借来的，并非我自己的财产。
如果你现在不亲自出面，
事情将陷入僵局，进一步的谈判只会导致时间的浪费。
对我而言，目前度日如年。我正焦急地等待救援，因此写此信鼓励
你亲自努力来救我。当你收到这封信时，应找人私下
读给你听。你切勿向任何

pages.en:
Sheet No. 7.

No. 7 B (Contd).

body else. This is very important, otherwise trouble
is bound to occur. Instruct the ricsha coolie to visit
(? the letter box in) the courtyard from time to time
and to be on the look-out for any further communications
thereby avoiding unnecessary delay and waste of time.
This is important, and I earnestly hope that you will act
accordingly.

Ding Feng.
pages.zh:
第7页。

第7 B号（续）。

其他人展示此信。这一点非常重要，否则麻烦
必将发生。指示黄包车夫不时前往
（？信筒位于）庭院中，并留意是否有进一步的通信，
从而避免不必要的延误和时间浪费。
这很重要，我恳切希望你能照此办理。

丁凤。
